verdicts.evidence: A synthetic geometry check recovered latent trajectories with max error 6.90e-06 and reprojection error 3.74e-06, validating the projection/inversion math, but only on synthetic data; real execution is blocked by missing lvcg.data modules.

Training cannot import due to missing modules; the released code adds a unit-weight base-beat loss absent from Equation 7 and required a post-paper GRU shape fix, so the objective as described could not be executed or confirmed.

Released splits are disjoint and Table-1 averages are arithmetically consistent, but no checkpoints or result files are released, the checkpoint override is ineffective, and PTB-XL Sub-Class label ordering differs between splits, so the reported AUC values were never reproduced.
The repository contains no checkpoints, reconstruction predictions, per-lead outputs, or metric files; Table 2 numbers cannot be regenerated.
No ablation configs, checkpoints, seeds, or outputs are released; the ablation numbers in Table 4 are display-only and cannot be reproduced.

The paper evaluates MIMIC-IV-ECG-Ext-ICD but the repository supplies an AI-READI provider instead, with no paper-dataset loader, folds, labels, checkpoint, or outputs; neither the CKD AUC nor the temporal-module ablation could be run.

overall: The logbook establishes only that the VCG geometry math is numerically sound on synthetic data and that the released data splits are disjoint with internally consistent table averages. No empirical result table could be reproduced because the package cannot import, no checkpoints are released, and several paper–code discrepancies (extra loss term, wrong non-cardiac dataset, label-ordering issues) block execution.
